tools.name: create_crossword
tools.description: Create a crossword puzzle URL. You must provide the list of words and hints. The list must have between 3 and 30 pairs words/hints. If user specifies count/topic, generate appropriate words and hints first, then call this tool with the words parameter.

tools.name: create_audio_crossword
tools.description: Create an audio crossword puzzle URL. Unlike the classic crossword, clues are not text hints: each word itself is played back as audio, so the player hears the word and must spell it. You must provide only the list of words (no hints). tools.name: create_word_search
tools.description: Create a word search puzzle URL. You must provide the list of words (no hints needed). The list must have between 3 and 30 words. If user specifies count/topic, generate appropriate words first, then call this tool with the words parameter.

tools.name: create_cryptogram
tools.description: Create a cryptogram puzzle URL. You must provide the secret sentence/message to encode (at least 5 distinct letters). tools.name: create_cross_math
tools.description: Create a cross-math puzzle URL. A cross-math puzzle is a crossword-shaped grid of arithmetic expressions (e.g. "12 + 7 = 19") where some numbers are hidden and the player must fill them in. All parameters are optional; sensible defaults are used when omitted.
